introducedNotes.description: This is the note Low G. Low G sits under the 2nd leger line underneath the music stave. It is often tricky to play, especially if you have small fingers, since the hole is so big and hard to fully cover. Take your time placing your right ring finger down and even use a mirror to help you see if there are any little gaps around the pad of your finger to cover up.
